requestedWeeks.description: What the user asked for (q35); null when no wish

rule.description: Lets the app re-estimate after Adjust targets, in this order: pace = 7 × |maintenanceKcal − targetKcal| ÷ kcalPerKg (kg a week); min = ceil(changeKg ÷ pace); max = ceil(min × slowdownFactor)

PlanNarrative.description: Qualitative AI personalisation. Never contains calorie, macro, weight or time numbers: those come from the validated calculation

message.description: Shown to the user when status is not ok

PlanNotice.description: Static, reviewed copy for outcomes that do not get a calorie plan

stale.description: Answers changed after this draft was made: regenerate before confirming

preview.description: Validated numbers (eligible=false when status is not ready)

basis.description: How the estimate works and what it assumes, in plain language

narrative.description: null unless ai.status is ok. Never fabricated

regenerations.description: Earlier drafts for these same answers

locale.description: Language code of every text in this draft (en, bn). Same answers in another language are a new draft

regenerate.description: Ask for a fresh personalisation even though these answers already have one

draftId.description: The reviewed draft this plan was confirmed from; null for plans made without one

timeframe.description: Estimate stored with the plan, re-calculated for the confirmed targets

locale.description: Language code of the stored tips and notes; null for plans made without a draft

incomplete.description: Nutrients unknown for at least one counted item

name.description: Publisher of the record, for display

RichIn.description: Vitamins and minerals this food is a good source of, strongest first. Names only, no amounts; empty when unknown

scanItemId.description: AnalysedItem.id: the server rebuilds this item from the stored scan, ignoring the numbers sent here

per100g.description: Basis for items not from a scan; item values are then computed from it

barcode.description: From GET /foods/barcode/{code}: the server takes the basis and source of that product, ignoring the numbers sent here

date.description: Defaults to the day of loggedAt in timezone (BR-07)

imageKey.description: Key from POST /uploads/presign: "Save photo and finish later" saves a photo-only meal (items may be empty)

url.description: Signed URL (1024 px when ready, else the original), valid 1 hour

thumbUrl.description: Signed 320 px thumbnail URL once the thumbnail job has run

crop.description: The food and its whole vessel, from the scan; show the photo through this window when present

amountMl.description: Positive to add, negative to undo

nudge.description: Rule-based nudge; copy lives in content

date.description: Day key YYYY-MM-DD in the entry timezone

everyHours.description: Ring again every N hours after `time`, up to `endTime`. Missing or null = once a day

timezone.description: Device timezone; defaults to the profile timezone

endTime.description: Last ring of the day when `everyHours` is set

id.description: Stable within one scan; send it back as scanItemId

canonicalName.description: English name used to look up records

excluded.description: Left out of totals, for example an ingredient of a mixed dish

countedIn.description: id of the mixed dish that already contains this item

isEstimate.description: true for a meal photo (it cannot establish weight, ingredients or hidden oil); false for values read from a label

crop.description: The food and the whole of its vessel, with a margin, for showing the photo; null or absent when the photo is already about the food

mode.description: meal (default): estimate a served meal; label: read the nutrition table on a pack

barcode.description: Label scans only: the pack's barcode, so GET /foods/barcode/{code} finds this label next time

addedItems.description: Foods added by text after the scan

totals.description: Counted items after the portion multiplier

staleItems.description: Renamed items with no matching record: their nutrition is still the earlier estimate

text.description: Typed text or the on-device transcript

mode.description: describe (default): whole meal; add_item: one food missed by a scan

experiments.description: This user's variants; empty when signed out

text.description: Typed text or the on-device transcript

chipIndex.description: Index into the chips of the last reply

maxSeconds.description: The app ends the session after this long

sessionKind.description: resume: the conversation was already under way

tone.description: warm (default, no extra rule) | cheerful | calm | direct

notes.description: Things the person asked Milo to remember, in their own words
At most 20 notes of 1 to 200 characters each (after trimming); duplicates are dropped

loggedDays.description: Days in the range with at least one meal

averageKcal.description: Average energy over logged days; null in habits_only mode

waterAvgMl.description: Average water on the days water was logged, to the nearest 10 ml; 0 when none

waterTargetMl.description: Daily water target of the active plan (the default target without a plan)

waterGoalDays.description: Days in the range that reached the water target

proteinGoalDays.description: Logged days that reached the protein target; null in habits_only mode or without a protein target

streak.description: Current logging streak (the number Today shows)

favouriteFood.description: Food logged most often in the range (in at least 2 meals), else null

id.description: Topic of the card: logging, meals, energy, protein, water, streak, favourite or next_week (a repeat gets -2)

text.description: At most 160 characters; every number in it is one of the stats

weekEnd.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the Sunday for last, today for this

mode.description: habits_only: no calorie numbers anywhere in the recap

cards.description: Milo's story cards in the app language; empty when ai is false (build cards from stats)

ai.description: false: nothing logged, Milo is resting, the daily limit is used or the answer was unusable

generatedAt.description: When stats and cards were computed. A recap with cards is kept: for the week (last) or the day (this)

uploadKey.description: `key` from POST /uploads/presign (kind meal_photo, image/jpeg) after the PUT. The photo is deleted after this call, whatever its outcome

why.description: One short line on why it fits

kcal.description: Estimated energy per serving; null in habits_only mode or when unknown

uses.description: Ingredients from the photo it uses

extra.description: Common items it also needs that are not in the photo

notFood.description: No usable food or ingredients found in the photo; ingredients and ideas are then empty

ingredients.description: What Milo could see, at most 15

ideas.description: At most 3; never with a listed allergen or against the eating pattern

found.description: false: unknown barcode. Offer a label scan (POST /scans with mode "label" and this barcode)

complete.description: Energy and the three macros are known. When false, a label scan gives better numbers

servingG.description: One serving in g (or ml), when known

servingText.description: Serving as printed on the pack

packG.description: Net weight or volume of the pack

per100g.description: Per 100 g (or 100 ml); null when unknown, never 0 as a guess

source.description: product_database (Open Food Facts) or package_label (your own label scan); null when not found
